./.title: Introduction
./.body:
Sheer Theme Documentation
Sheer is a beauty-first Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme for skincare, makeup, and wellness brands. It combines editorial layouts, rich imagery, conversion-focused product pages, and flexible section-based customization — no coding required for most day-to-day changes.
This guide is written for merchants using the theme editor.
What you will find here



Section
Topics




Getting started
Install, theme editor basics, demo collections


Theme settings
Layout, colors, fonts, swatches, search, social


Global layout
Header, footer, cart drawer, languages & markets


Homepage sections
Hero video, product grids, collage, before/after, and more


Page templates
Product, collection, search, blog, contact, gift card


Customization
Section colors, filters, metafields


Support
Email contact, troubleshooting, FAQ



Quick start checklist

Upload logo and favicon — Theme settings → Logo
Set brand colors — Theme settings → Colors
Configure header navigation — Header section
Add Search & discovery filters — Shopify admin
Review homepage sections — Theme editor → Homepage
Test Add to cart → cart drawer → checkout

Need help?
See Contact us or Quick fixes if something does not look right.

getting-started/install.html.title: Install & publish
getting-started/install.html.body:
Install & publish
Install the theme

In Shopify admin, go to Online Store → Themes.
Click Add theme:
Upload zip file — if you received Sheer as a .zip
Or install from the Theme Store when published


Click Customize on Sheer to open the theme editor.
When ready, click Publish to make Sheer your live storefront theme.


Tip: Before major changes, use Duplicate on your theme in Online Store → Themes so you always have a backup.

Recommended first steps



#
Task
Where




1
Upload logo and favicon
Theme settings → Logo


2
Set brand colors
Theme settings → Colors


3
Choose primary font
Theme settings → Typography


4
Configure header menu
Header section


5
Add social profile URLs
Theme settings → Social media


6
Set up Search & discovery filters
Shopify admin → Search & discovery


7
Review homepage sections
Theme editor → Homepage


8
Customize product page blocks
Theme editor → Product page


9
Test Add to cart → cart drawer → checkout
Storefront



Update the theme
When a new version of Sheer is released:

Duplicate your current theme (backup).
Upload or install the new version.
Compare Theme settings and section settings against your backup.
Publish when satisfied.

Keep a backup before updating — settings do not always merge automatically between versions.

theme-settings/animation.html.title: Animation
theme-settings/animation.html.body:
Animation
Theme settings → Animation controls movement and visual effects across your storefront.
Settings
Enable scroll animations
When turned on, sections fade and slide into view as customers scroll down the page. Headings appear first, followed by product cards and images in a staggered sequence. This creates a polished, editorial feel similar to premium brand websites.
When turned off, all content appears immediately with no entrance effects — cleaner for stores that prefer a static layout.
Default: On
Stagger delay
Controls the timing gap between each card or item appearing in sequence. A lower number creates a faster, tighter cascade. A higher number slows the reveal for a more dramatic, drawn-out entrance.



Setting
Effect




0 ms
All items appear simultaneously


80 ms (default)
Subtle ripple — items appear one after another


200 ms
Slow, dramatic reveal — each item clearly separates



Animation speed
Sets how quickly elements complete their entrance animation.



Speed
Duration
Best for




Slow
~1 second
Luxury, high-end — emphasis on each element


Medium (default)
~0.7 seconds
Balanced — noticeable but not distracting


Fast
~0.4 seconds
Energetic, fast-paced — quick browsing



Show quick-add on hover
When enabled on desktop, product card buttons (Add to cart, Choose options, Sold out) are hidden by default and slide into view when the customer hovers over a product card. This creates a cleaner, less cluttered grid while keeping purchasing actions accessible.
On mobile, buttons remain always visible since hover is not available.
Default: Off (buttons always visible)
Accessibility
All animations respect your customers' operating system accessibility settings. If a customer has Reduce motion enabled (Mac: Accessibility → Display, Windows: Accessibility → Visual effects), all scroll animations and shimmer effects are automatically disabled. No extra setup required.
Dark mode
Your theme's color scheme setting is under Theme settings → Layout → Color scheme, with three options:



Option
Behavior




Light only
Always light background


System preference (default)
Follows the customer's OS dark mode setting


Dark only
Always dark background



When dark mode is active, the theme uses a warm dark palette (#171a17 background) designed specifically for beauty and skincare brands, ensuring product imagery remains the focal point.

sections/shade-finder.html.title: Shade finder
sections/shade-finder.html.body:
Shade finder
Let shoppers preview every color of a product and add their match to cart — perfect for foundation, lipstick, blush, or any product with color/shade variants.
Setup

Add the Shade finder section.
Pick a Product that has color or shade variants.
In Variant option to use, type the option name exactly as it appears on the product (for example Color or Shade). If left blank or unmatched, the first option is used.

How it works

Each variant value becomes a round swatch. The swatch color comes from the variant image when available, otherwise from the variant value name.
Tapping a swatch updates the preview image, shade name, price, and the Add to cart button — which opens the cart drawer without leaving the page.
Shoppers can set a quantity with the +/− stepper before adding; the chosen amount is added to the cart. Quantity can also be changed later inside the cart drawer.
Sold-out shades stay visible but cannot be added.

sections/stock-counter.html.title: Stock counter
sections/stock-counter.html.body:
Stock counter
Create urgency with one or more "selling fast" progress bars. Add a Stock counter block for each campaign or product. Use manual numbers for a promotion, or read live inventory from a product.
Setup

Add the Stock counter section.
Click Add block → Stock counter for each bar you need (up to 8).
In each block, choose how the remaining count is calculated:
Manual: set Total units (goal) and Remaining units.
Live inventory: enable Use live product inventory and pick a Product whose inventory is tracked.


Optionally set a Button that links to the product or collection.
Under section settings, set Counters per row on desktop (1–4). Fewer counters than the column setting expand to fill the row width.

customization/animations.html.title: Scroll animations
customization/animations.html.body:
Scroll animations
Sheer includes built-in scroll-triggered entrance animations that add an editorial, premium feel to your storefront. No coding required.
How it works
As customers scroll down the page:

Section headings (eyebrow text, title, description) fade up into view
Product cards and image grids appear one after another in a staggered ripple — each card follows the previous one by the stagger delay set in Animation settings

The effect is subtle and professional — similar to what you see on Awwwards-winning brand websites.
Which sections are animated

Controlling animations
Go to Theme settings → Animation to:

Turn all animations off — uncheck "Enable scroll animations"
Adjust stagger delay — how quickly cards follow each other (0–200ms)
Change speed — slow / medium / fast

Animations only play once when the element first enters the viewport. Scrolling back up and down won't re-trigger them.
Loading skeletons
When a section has no content configured yet (for example, a product card section without a selected collection), it displays skeleton placeholders — gray cards with a shimmering light sweep. This gives a polished, app-like loading feel instead of blank space.
The skeletons are automatically replaced with real content once you configure the section in the theme editor.
Hover effects
Product cards
On desktop, hovering over a product card triggers:

Image zoom — the product image gently scales up (4%)
Shadow lift — the card gains depth with a soft shadow
Quick-add reveal — if "Show quick-add on hover" is enabled in Animation settings, the Add to cart button slides into view

Buttons
All primary buttons have a subtle lift and glow effect on hover, reinforcing the clickable area.
Accessibility
All animations are automatically disabled for customers who have Reduce motion turned on in their operating system. The theme also provides a global Enable scroll animations toggle in the theme editor for merchants who prefer a static layout.

customization/faceted-search.html.title: Faceted search
customization/faceted-search.html.body:
Faceted search
Sheer displays filters configured in Shopify admin — the theme does not hard-code filter types.
Setup

Shopify admin → Search & discovery
Click Filters
Add filter:




Filter type
Beauty example




Availability
In stock / out of stock


Price
Price ranges


Product type
Skincare, Makeup, Tools


Vendor
Brand filters


Variant option
Color, Size, Finish


Metafield
Skin type, concern




Save
Preview collection and search pages on the storefront

Filter UX

Filter button opens left drawer
Active filters show as pills above the grid
Remove one pill, or use the Clear all button (toolbar + drawer footer)
Drawer footer: Clear all (secondary) + Apply (primary)
Apply closes drawer on mobile

Filters not showing?
Add filters in Search & discovery, not the theme editor.
Swatch filters
Keep variant option names consistent (e.g. always “Color”) so swatch filters work across the catalog.

customization/metafields.html.title: Metafields & dynamic content
customization/metafields.html.body:
Metafields & dynamic content
Sheer supports Shopify dynamic sources on compatible settings (e.g. collapsible row content linked to product metafields).
Example — ingredients in a collapsible row

Create a product metafield: Settings → Custom data → Products
Fill the metafield on each product
Theme editor → Product → Collapsible row block → connect content to metafield

Use metafields for reusable specs (SPF, skin type, volume) without duplicating text across products.
Metafield filters
After defining product metafields, you can add them as filters in Search & discovery for collection and search pages.

support/quick-fixes.html.title: Quick fixes
support/quick-fixes.html.body:
Quick fixes
Theme editor changes not showing?

Click Save in the theme editor.
Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5 / Cmd+Shift+R).
Confirm the published theme is live.

Filters missing on collection/search?
Configure in Shopify admin → Search & discovery → Filters, not the theme editor.
Beauty collage empty

Collection mode: Select collection, set Products to show, remove Product tile blocks.
Manual mode: Add Product tile blocks or set fallback collection.

Wrong variant swatch color
Theme settings → Variant swatches → Custom swatch colors — add name:#HEX per line.
No quick add on product cards
Expected for multi-variant products — they link to the product page.
Savings badge empty
Product not on sale, or disable Show savings on the Price block.
Hero video not autoplaying
Mobile browsers often require muted video — the theme mutes by default.
Collection tab empty
Collection has no products or wrong collection selected in the block.
More issues
See FAQ or Contact us.

support/faq.html.title: FAQ
support/faq.html.body:
FAQ
How do I add a new homepage section?
Theme editor → Homepage → Add section → configure → Save.
How do I change the product page layout?
Product page → Product section → add, remove, or reorder blocks.
Can I use Custom Liquid?
Yes — Custom Liquid block on product page or Custom Liquid section. Test on a duplicate theme first.
Where is the cart drawer configured?
Cart drawer section in the theme editor. Enable Cart note there if needed.
Does Sheer work with my apps?
Sheer uses standard Online Store 2.0 patterns (sections, app blocks, Ajax cart). Most reputable apps work. If an app replaces cart or product forms, note the app name when contacting support.
Can you install the theme for me?
Email support with requirements — paid setup may be available.
How do I enable multiple languages?
Settings → Languages, then Header → enable Language selector. Translate under Settings → Languages → Translate.
